key.name: jira-site

key.summary: Clockify API key (Profile -> Settings -> API)

key.summary: Default value of the billable toggle on new Clockify entries

key.summary: Max issues to show in the picker

key.summary: Show the rings / subtasks / heatmap panel below the calendar

key.summary: Show the parent-issue column in the subtask table

key.summary: Board id used by the agile-board strategy

key.summary: Show Google Calendar events as immovable background blocks

key.summary: OAuth refresh token from the one-time device-code authorization
